name: Morty's Cafe Utah Scone Fries with Honey Butter & Powdered Sugar
whyItWorks: Strips of pillowy white bread dough fried golden and dusted with powdered sugar have zero roughage or seeds, making them a fun USU campus treat in remission when shared.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share a basket of Scone Fries dusted with powdered sugar and dip lightly in honey butter (skip raspberry jam if it contains seeds).
watchOuts: Deep-fried dough absorbs fryer oil—keep portion small and avoid during active flares
